summary: Dry Saturday with a cold, damp start (about 1 °C at Medinaceli and Daroca, humidity near 100%) so frost or fog patches are possible early, then 11–15 °C; no AEMET warnings for Soria. AEMET hourly pages for Medinaceli and Daroca were stale and discarded (daily tables used); the Zaragoza warnings page was stale, so Zaragoza warnings are unchecked.
sunset: Clear sky over Madrid around sunset (17:50), about 10 °C.

verdict.text: Near 0 °C at dawn on the A-2 at Medinaceli (about 1 °C, humidity near 100%) and around Daroca (1 °C), so frost or fog patches are possible on the morning drive; dry with light wind, 11–15 °C by afternoon. Drive gently on bridges and shaded stretches before 10:30.
